sloka: ततो लक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौ हनुमांश्च प्लवङ्गमः ।निशम्य वाक्यं रामस्य बभूवुर्व्यथिता भृशम् ।। ६.११७.३१ ।।
transliteration: tato lakṣmaṇasugrīvau hanumāṁśca plavaṅgamaḥ ।niśamya vākyaṁ rāmasya babhūvurvyathitā bhṛśam ।। 6.117.31 ।।

translations.english: Rama having spoken clearly in that way, Vibheeshana reverently conducted Sita to Rama.
